candidate_reference_exception.question: May existing A023 and the three new boss candidates be used as references for creating final batch review, without approving or integrating them?
candidate_reference_exception.scope: Use existing A023 and new A052/A053/A054 candidate raw masters as identity/style references for A056 final batch review. Their approval prerequisites are waived for reference use only.

deviations: The source-count field in the pack says 22 but its table and generation steps require 23 ImageGen sources (one cover, four tabs, four trophies, blank medal master, twelve badge edits, one ornament). The 23 items required by the detailed instructions were generated.

All badges share a scale chosen to fit the largest measured emblem crop; this is slightly below the written 22px/blank-master scale because the Year Two sprout extends beyond the master bounds. Badge raw crop bounds vary by more than the stated ±2%, so visual rim/ribbon alignment still needs owner review.

deviations.change: The owner approved the displayed artwork, including the documented visual QA differences.
